integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Ready connectors that create endpoints, routes and settings for you.
integrations.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage integrations.
integrations.uninstall_body: Remove “{name}” and the resources it created?
integrations.desc_sso-authentik: OIDC single sign-on preset for Authentik. Use Settings → OIDC “Start from a preset”, or install to seed the defaults.
integrations.desc_sso-keycloak: OIDC single sign-on preset for Keycloak. Use Settings → OIDC “Start from a preset”, or install to seed the defaults.
integrations.desc_sso-entra: OIDC single sign-on preset for Microsoft Entra ID. Use Settings → OIDC “Start from a preset”, or install to seed the defaults.
integrations.desc_sso-google: OIDC single sign-on preset for Google Workspace. Use Settings → OIDC “Start from a preset”, or install to seed the defaults.
integrations.desc_sso-okta: OIDC single sign-on preset for Okta. Use Settings → OIDC “Start from a preset”, or install to seed the defaults.
integrations.desc_gdrive: Export attachments to Google Drive using a pasted OAuth refresh token. File bytes leave EmailBridge to Google.
integrations.desc_onedrive: Export attachments to OneDrive or SharePoint using a pasted OAuth refresh token. File bytes leave EmailBridge to Microsoft.
integrations.desc_grafana: Import the bundled EmailBridge Grafana dashboard for mail, sync and delivery metrics.
integrations.desc_loki: Preset Loki label set for the EmailBridge stdout log mirror (service, role, node).
integrations.desc_otel: Bundled OpenTelemetry collector configuration for EmailBridge traces and metrics.
integrations.desc_sentry: Instance error reporting for any Sentry-compatible DSN (Sentry or GlitchTip). Installable only in the instance owner's organisation.
